notes: Corrected: `רֹמַ֣מְתִּי` and `עֶ֔זֶר` were held in one fused unit on the ground that dividing *Romamti ezer* between them would be arbitrary. It is not: *Romamti* writes the first token and *ezer* the second, so each morpheme has a rendering of its own, rule 30's one-English-rendering condition is unmet, and rule 2 splits them. Rule 6's fallback anchor does not arise, since the unit is not indivisible.
The marginal notes on Azarel and Shubael were read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
